chain_words.nuance: to fail to notice or recall something in passing
to leave something out deliberately or accidentally
to lose a memory of something
to remove a memory or trace completely
to destroy every trace of something, so that nothing remains

explanation: These words all describe losing a memory, from a passing oversight to a total erasure of every trace.

usage_notes.difference: 'Erase' means removing a memory or trace; 'obliterate' means destroying every trace so completely that nothing remains.
